scores.reasons: Gap: site is modern, mobile-clean and already agent-commerce ready; only local metadata and appointment/delivery scheduling are missing. Pay: 35-year-old family retailer with 45+ brands and high-ticket furniture plus delivery revenue. Ease: schema, titles and a booking widget. Evidence: robots.txt, ld+json, phone view and product pages inspected directly.

caveats: Ratings and review counts were read from third-party aggregators (Birdeye, Loc8NearMe, Jewelry Store Directory, Yellowbot, localitybiz) because Google Maps pages could not be opened directly; aggregator counts for the same business often disagreed, and Google Business Profile completeness (categories, services, photos) could not be verified for any business.
Small-business JSON-LD checks were done in the live browser on each homepage only; inner pages may carry schema that the homepage lacks.
Phone-width review used a 390 px CSS viewport in a real Chrome; screenshots were taken for nine of ten businesses (Christy's Florist was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge).
Contact and quote forms were examined (fields, labels, CAPTCHA presence) but never submitted, per the read-only brief.
Operating status is based on the live website plus third-party listings; no business was phoned or emailed to confirm current ownership, hours or staff counts.
data_gaps: Christy's Florist (B00564): the entire website sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge and returns HTTP 403 to non-browser requests, including /robots.txt. No site content, schema, checkout path or mobile layout could be assessed; all findings about the site are marked unknown or inference.

The Bird House (B00562): Chrome returned ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT for the http homepage and ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID for https, so no screenshot was captured; the page and its raw HTML were retrieved over plain HTTP instead. Google Business Profile rating and claim status not verified.
Planet Bike (B00558): no tel: link, contact form or booking flow found, but the site's JavaScript navigation was not exhaustively clicked; a deeper review could find one under the hamburger menu.

American Jewelry Supply (B00555): listing rating is reported inconsistently (4.4/29 on one directory, 3.9 on another); store hours and address were not found on the site and were not confirmed from a primary source.
Total Party (B00568): no Google rating could be confirmed; the only rating found (5/5 from 3 reviews) is on Yellowbot and mostly dates to about 2014.
American Jewelry Supply, 18 Lumber, GMI Designs, Aquaridise and The Bird House have no public price lists for services or equipment, so price-range answerability could not be judged beyond 'absent'.
